description:
BirdNET Live Setup


What's Changed
- Implement upload release assets action to handle file conflicts by @kahst in #261
- Implement scene lifecycle support and fix launch issues on iOS 27 by @kahst in #264
- Export Raven frequency bounds as doubles for compatibility by @kahst in #266
- Enforce minimum zoom level to prevent app freeze on pinch-out by @kahst in #267
- Refactor TTS implementation to use a custom platform channel by @kahst in #268
- Enhance audio processing and background service stability by @kahst in #270
- Upgrade ONNX Runtime and migrate to built-in Kotlin by @kahst in #271
- Enhance iOS audio recording and session management by @kahst in #272
- Update version to 1.2.1 and documentation by @kahst in #273
Full Changelog: v1.2.0...v1.2.1
